camel_example: aliyun ims CreateApplication --region cn-hangzhou --DisplayName myapp --AppType WebApp
kebab_example: aliyun ims create-application --display-name myapp --app-type WebApp --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateApplication

parameters.help_en:
The display name of the application.

Maximum length: 24 characters
parameters.help_zh:
应用的显示名称。

最大长度为24个字符
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en:
The application type. Valid values:

WebApp: web applications that interact with users through browsers. 
NativeApp: native applications that run in operating systems, primarily on desktop or shift operating systems. 
ServerApp: applications that directly access Alibaba Cloud services without requiring user logons. Currently, only user synchronization applications based on the System for Cross-domain Identity Management protocol are supported
parameters.help_zh:
应用类型。取值：

WebApp：指基于浏览器交互的网络应用。 
NativeApp：指操作系统中运行的本地应用，主要为运行在桌面操作系统或移动操作系统中的应用。 
ServerApp：指直接访问阿里云服务，而无需依赖用户登录的应用，目前仅支持基于SCIM协议的用户同步应用
parameters.name: app_type

parameters.help_en:
The redirect URIs.

Separate multiple URIs with semicolons (;)
parameters.help_zh:
回调地址。

输入多个时，以英文分号（;）分隔
parameters.name: redirect_uris

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether an application secret is required. Valid values:

true
false

+ For WebApp and ServerApp applications, this value is forcibly set to true and cannot be modified.
+ For NativeApp applications, you can set this value to true or false. If you do not specify this value, the default value is false. Because such applications often run in untrusted environments and cannot effectively protect application secrets, do not set this value to true unless necessary. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93697.html
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要应用密钥。取值：

true
false

+ 对于WebApp和ServerApp类型的应用，该值会被强制设置为true，不支持修改。
+ 对于NativeApp类型的应用，可以设置为true或false，如不设置，默认为false。由于此类应用往往运行在非可信环境，无法有效保护应用密钥，因此建议您如无明确需要，不要设置为true。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93697.html
parameters.name: secret_required

parameters.help_en:
The validity period of the access token.

Valid values: 900 to 10800. Unit: seconds.

Default value: 3600
parameters.help_zh:
访问令牌有效期。

取值范围：900~10800。单位：秒。

默认值：3600
parameters.name: access_token_validity

parameters.help_en:
The validity period of the refresh token.

Valid values: 7200 to 31536000. Unit: seconds.

Default value:

For NativeApp and ServerApp applications, if this value is empty, the default value is 2592000 seconds (30 days).
For WebApp applications, if this value is empty, the default value is 7776000 seconds (90 days)
parameters.help_zh:
刷新令牌有效期。

取值范围：7200~31536000。单位：秒。

默认值：

对于NativeApp和ServerApp类型的应用，如果该值为空，则默认为2592000秒（即30天）。
对于WebApp类型的应用，如果该值为空，则默认为7776000秒（即90天）
parameters.name: refresh_token_validity

parameters.help_en:
The scopes of the application.

For the valid values and descriptions of application scopes, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93693.html. You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187206.html operation to obtain the scopes supported by different application types.

Separate multiple scopes with semicolons (;)
parameters.help_zh:
应用权限范围。

关于应用权限范围的取值和描述，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93693.html。您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187206.html获取不同应用类型支持的应用权限范围。

输入多个应用权限范围时，以英文分号（;）分隔
parameters.name: predefined_scopes

parameters.help_en:
The required scopes of the application.

You can set one or more scopes in RequiredScopes as required. After a scope is set as required, it is selected by default and cannot be deselected when a user authorizes the application.

Separate multiple scopes with semicolons (;).

If a scope that you specify in RequiredScopes is not included in PredefinedScopes, the required scope does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
必选的应用权限范围。

您可以将`RequiredScopes`中设置的一个或多个范围设为必选，设为必选后，当用户进行应用授权时，必选范围默认选中且不可取消。

输入多个应用权限范围时，以英文分号（;）分隔。

如果您设置的`RequiredScopes`项不在`PredefinedScopes`的范围内，则该项必选范围不生效
parameters.name: required_scopes

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the application can be installed by other accounts. Valid values:

true: For NativeApp and ServerApp applications, if this value is empty, the default value is true.
false: For WebApp applications, if this value is empty, the default value is false
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许被其他账号安装。取值：

true：对于NativeApp和ServerApp类型的应用，如果该值为空，则默认为true。
false：对于WebApp类型的应用，如果该值为空，则默认为false
parameters.name: is_multi_tenant

parameters.help_en:
The application name.

The maximum length is 64 characters. Only letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-) are allowed
parameters.help_zh:
应用名称。

最大长度为64 个字符，允许输入英文字母、数字、英文句点（.）、下划线（_）或中划线（-）
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en:
The OAuth protocol version of the application. Valid values:
2.0: OAuth 2.0 protocol.
2.1: OAuth 2.1 protocol.

Default value: 2.0
parameters.help_zh:
应用的OAuth协议版本。取值：
`2.0`：表示为OAuth 2.0协议。
`2.1`：表示为OAuth 2.1协议。

默认值：`2.0`
parameters.name: protocol_version

parameters.help_en:
The application assignment type. Valid values:

AllowAll: assigns the application to all RAM users and roles in the account, allowing them to use the application.
OnDemand: assigns the application only to specified RAM users and roles in the account, allowing only them to use the application
parameters.help_zh:
应用分配类型。取值：

AllowAll：全分配，允许账号下所有子用户和角色使用该应用。
OnDemand：按需分配，仅允许账号下指定子用户和角色使用该应用
parameters.name: assignment_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether user authorization is required. Valid values:

true: In addition to the authorization required during application installation, users must also authorize the application each time they use it for OAuth logon.
false: Authorization is required only during application installation. Users do not need additional authorization when they use the application for OAuth logon later
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要用户授权。取值：

true：除安装该应用时需要授权外，用户每次使用该应用进行 OAuth 登录时，也需要进行授权。
false：仅安装该应用时需要授权，后续用户使用该应用进行 OAuth 登录时无需额外授权
parameters.name: need_principal_consent

AccessTokenValidity.description_en: The validity period of the access token. Unit: seconds
AccessTokenValidity.description_zh: 访问令牌有效期。单位：秒

AccountId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID to which the application belongs
AccountId.description_zh: 应用所属的阿里云账号ID

OnDemand: assigns the application only to specified RAM users and roles in the account, allowing only them to use the application
AssignmentType.description_zh:
应用分配类型。取值：
AllowAll：全分配，允许账号下所有子用户和角色使用该应用。
OnDemand：按需分配，仅允许账号下指定子用户和角色使用该应用

CreateDate.description_en:
The creation time.

Format: RFC 3339 (UTC). Example: 2020-10-23T08:06:57Z

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the application

IsMultiTenant.description_en: Indicates whether the application can be installed by other accounts
IsMultiTenant.description_zh: 是否允许被其他账号安装

NeedPrincipalConsent.description_en:
Specifies whether user authorization is required. Valid values:
true: User authorization is required.
false: User authorization is not required
NeedPrincipalConsent.description_zh:
是否需要用户授权。取值：
true：需要用户授权。
false：不需要用户授权

ProtocolVersion.description_en:
The OAuth protocol version of the application. Valid values:
2.0: OAuth 2.0 protocol.
2.1: OAuth 2.1 protocol
ProtocolVersion.description_zh:
应用的OAuth协议版本。取值：
`2.0`：表示为OAuth 2.0协议。
`2.1`：表示为OAuth 2.1协议

RefreshTokenValidity.description_en: The validity period of the refresh token. Unit: seconds
RefreshTokenValidity.description_zh: 刷新令牌有效期。单位：秒

SecretRequired.description_en: Indicates whether an application secret is required

UpdateDate.description_en:
The update time.

Format: RFC 3339 (UTC). Example: 2020-10-23T08:06:57Z
